title: The Freezer role can strip a Relayer's permissions but cannot grant them
content:
A.6.1.1.1.2.6.1.2.2.1.1.2 sets an asymmetric permission: "The Relayer Role may be granted to an address by any address holding the `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`. The Relayer Role may be removed from an address by any address holding the `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` **or the `FREEZER_ROLE`**."

The Freezer therefore holds a revoke-only power over the actor that moves capital. It can end the automated Planner's authority immediately, without waiting for Sky Governance to act through the Spark Proxy, and without ever being able to appoint a Relayer of its own choosing.

This is the same design principle as the Avalanche governance bridge Guardian, whose power is "strictly limited to cancelling pending actions" with no admin control. In both cases the fast emergency key can only subtract capability. A compromised Freezer can halt Spark's operations — a denial of service that Sky Governance can repair by re-granting roles — but it cannot redirect funds or install its own operator.

Stated generally: give emergency responders the minimum power that stops the bleeding and no power that could cause it. The recovery path is deliberately slower and sits with admin, because reinstating authority is a decision that should be deliberate while withdrawing it must be instant.
description: RELAYER_ROLE may be granted only by DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, yet removed by either admin or FREEZER_ROLE — the emergency key's power is deliberately subtractive only.
